description: Android Fragment class for handling screen capture UI and logic, including starting/stopping virtual display and media projection.

classes.name: ScreenCaptureFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment providing UI and logic for screen capture, managing media projection and virtual display.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and sets click listener.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up display metrics and media projection manager.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current result code and data.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles toggle button to start or stop screen capture.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from screen capture permission request.

methods.name: startScreenCapture
methods.description: Initiates screen capture process, requesting permission if needed.

methods.name: setUpVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Creates virtual display for screen capture.

methods.name: stopScreenCapture
methods.description: Releases virtual display and stops capture.
